def inspect(it):
 name,repo,rev,path,blob,size=it
 r={'name':name,'revision':rev}
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/'+repo+'/'+rev+'/'+path,timeout=12) as f:b=f.read(400001)
  assert len(b)==size and hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+bytes([0])+b).hexdigest()==blob
  r.update(verified=True,sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
  if name=='CAMARA':
   s=b.decode('utf-8');block=s.split('    SubscriptionStatusResponse:',1)[1].split('    PhoneNumber:',1)[0].split('      properties:',1)[1]
   props=re.findall(r'^        ([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*):\s*$',block,re.M)
   assert set(props)=={'voiceSmsIn','voiceSmsOut','dataService'}
   r.update(response_fields=props,explicit_fidelity=False)
  else:
   s=json.loads(b);d=s['definitions'];models={'TMF651':['Agreement','AgreementItem','AgreementTermOrCondition','TimePeriod'],'TMF637':['Product','ProductTerm','ProductPrice','TimePeriod'],'TMF678':['CustomerBill','TimePeriod']}[name]
   selected={k:list(d[k]['properties']) for k in models};r['fields']=selected
   if name=='TMF651':
    assert d['Agreement']['properties']['agreementPeriod']['$ref']=='#/definitions/TimePeriod'
    assert d['AgreementTermOrCondition']['properties']['validFor']['$ref']=='#/definitions/TimePeriod'
   elif name=='TMF637':
    assert d['Product']['properties']['productTerm']['items']['$ref']=='#/definitions/ProductTerm'
    assert d['ProductTerm']['properties']['validFor']['$ref']=='#/definitions/TimePeriod'
   else:
    assert 'amount due' in d['CustomerBill']['properties']['paymentDueDate']['description']
   r['explicit_fidelity_field']=any(re.search(r'fideliza|commitment|lock.?in|minimum.?contract',k,re.I) for p in selected.values() for k in p)
   r['version']=s['info']['version']
  r['pass']=True
 except Exception as e:r.update(pass_=False,error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:150])
 return r
